name: Lactation consultant

pf.license.need: optional, and never verified by Rosie: a consultant may add a lactation certification it holds (IBCLC or similar), and the business may add a registration; Rosie looks nothing up and never says anything is checked
pf.license.who: the business says what it holds; the owner adds each consultant's own number on the secure page
pf.license.ask: each consultant's certification number, if they hold one, in their invite reply (or the owner sends it)
pf.license.check: none: nothing is looked up; Rosie never says a certification was checked by Rosie
pf.license.blocks: the business's own word only: if the owner says a visit needs a certification a consultant doesn't have, that consultant isn't offered it
pf.license.video: a video visit with a consultant the owner says is certified, counted as at the office
pf.license.away: home visits only for the consultants the owner clears for home visits, and only where the owner says the place allows them
pf.license.lactation: the consultant's own certification, if the owner adds one: the owner's word, never checked
pf.license.vaccines: none: no vaccine orders are taken through Rosie
pf.license.agreement: a privacy agreement signed on the secure page before the first booking, where the family's health details are kept; every company in Rosie's chain signs one with Rosie
pf.license.renewals: none: Rosie keeps no renewal dates; the owner can note one by hand
pf.license.insurance: liability insurance, if the owner adds it: a note only, never checked
pf.license.claims: 'certified' or 'board-certified' is shown only where the owner says so; never as checked

pf.services.shape: breastfeeding support for a parent and baby: visits at the office, at home, or by video; a free phone chat to ask if a visit fits; visits are booked one at a time, with the next at checkout
pf.services.examples: the example business's own prices and lengths, not a standard

list.name: Free 15-minute phone chat
list.note: to ask what the parent needs and whether a visit fits

list.name: Lactation visit at the office
list.price: $120 (example), billed to the plan where it pays
list.after: the plan is billed; any share, or the self-pay $120, is paid at the front desk

list.name: Lactation visit at home
list.price: $150 (example), billed to the plan where it pays
list.after: the office bills the plan its own way; self-pay: the bill is texted after DONE

list.name: Video lactation visit
list.where: by video, counted as at the office

pf.services.capacity: one baby per visit; a second baby or a sibling is added as a second person on the same booking, each with their own time
pf.services.nobodyHome: never: a parent or guardian is always there
pf.services.online: video visits, counted as at the office, with the code read out at the start
pf.services.urgentFeeding: a baby who won't feed, or any worry about the baby, is sent to 911 or the baby's doctor first (pf.safety); a feeding question gets the soonest visit

beforeTimes: the first name of the parent booking
a new family or a current one
which visit: the office's own visit types only, never a symptom typed into the AI
where the visit is: at the office, by video, or at home (home visits only inside the business's area)
a plan (its name only) or self-pay
afterTime: anything the consultant should know to help, like needing an interpreter
the parent's name and mobile (for texts)
securePage: how the person booking is related to the baby
the plan's member ID, the plan holder and a photo of the plan card
the feeding history and the health history
the consents and the privacy notice
pf.questions.whoMayBook: a parent or guardian, or a support person the parent names on the secure page; a baby never books
pf.questions.whoMayBring: a parent or guardian brings the baby; another adult only with the parent's signed OK on the secure page
pf.questions.neverAsked: feeding problems, symptoms, weights and test results are never asked or typed in the AI chat

stop.words: trouble breathing, a seizure, a baby who isn't breathing, a baby who is blue or won't wake up, or heavy bleeding
stop.say: Call 911 now. Rosie can't book care for an emergency.
stop.booking: no booking; any visit stays booked

stop.say: Call Poison Help now at 1-800-222-1222. If the person isn't breathing or won't wake up, call 911.

stop.words: thoughts of harming yourself or the baby, or a crisis after the birth
stop.say: Call or text 988 now. If you are in danger, call 911. The consultant is told.
stop.booking: no booking; the same words in a later text get 988 again

nurseLine.words: the consultant's own list of signs that need the baby's doctor (the example list includes a baby who stops feeding or is very sleepy)
nurseLine.say: Please call the baby's doctor now: (555) 010-0177. If it's an emergency, call 911.
nurseLine.booking: no booking by Rosie until the baby's doctor has talked with the parent

goOn.words: a feeding question with nothing on the lists above
goOn.where: matched to the consultant's own visit: Rosie never judges how serious it is

pf.safety.always: the general screen: danger to life, fire, gas or a medical emergency gets 911, and words about self-harm get 988

steps.name: The feeding history, the health history and the consent
steps.when: on the secure page only, never by text; due before the first visit; one reminder before it's due
steps.result: not done by its due date: the consultant keeps the visit (signed on the secure page first), moves it, or cancels with no fee

steps.name: The plan check
steps.when: while booking, by the front desk, by hand
steps.who: every family that names a plan
steps.result: covered, some services only, not covered, or can't check now (the desk checks later, and the family may cancel free)

steps.name: A written price estimate for a self-pay family
steps.when: told while booking; sent within 1 business day
steps.result: a to-do for the office, with its due date

steps.name: The owner's OK for a new family
steps.when: before the first visit is booked
steps.result: OK: booked; no: told kindly, nothing kept

pf.first_steps.prep: arrive 10 minutes early; bring the plan card and the feeding log, if the family has one; a parent comes with the baby; at home: a clear place to sit

pf.visit.checkIn: at the office: the check-in code at the front desk; a video visit: the code read out at the start; at home: the code from the parent at the door
pf.visit.beforeWork: the consultant asks how feeding is going and looks at the baby's weight, before the visit's work starts
pf.visit.changes: a second visit or a test is added only with the parent's yes, with any price first
pf.visit.done: the check-in code or DONE; the consultant's notes stay with the consultant, never in Rosie or a text; a follow-up is booked at checkout
pf.visit.away: at home: the consultant brings a scale and her own supplies; a parent is there for the whole visit
pf.visit.childLeft: never: the parent stays for the whole visit

pf.money.before: nothing taken at booking for a visit the plan pays; a self-pay visit at the office takes nothing until the visit; a video visit is paid in full when booking; the free phone chat takes nothing
pf.money.plans: the plans the business takes (its own list); the front desk checks each plan by hand and records it; the share is an estimate, not a promise
pf.money.selfPay: a self-pay family is told the price before the yes, and gets a written estimate on time if it asks
pf.money.fees: no missed-visit fee by default; the owner may set one for self-pay visits only, and it is never more than the money paid now
pf.money.feeFree: a switch: no fee ever for families whose plan or the state's rules bar one, or whom the owner marks fee-free; their texts say 'No fee to cancel or miss'
pf.money.after: at the office: any share at the front desk; at home: the plan is billed the business's own way, or Rosie texts the self-pay bill after DONE
pf.money.caps: fee limits for plan clients: from the plan's and the state's rules
pf.money.rosfield: the $2 per booking applies, as for every kind of work (D97): a flat fee for each booking Rosie's AI makes; no memberships are sold here
pf.money.payOverTime: none: nothing is charged on set days by itself

pf.messages.never: texts carry only the business's name, the date, the time, the address and a secure link: never the visit type, the feeding, the baby's weight, symptoms or results (at a home visit the consultant's name stays, for the door check)
pf.messages.staff: texts to the owner and staff carry the family's initials, the time and a link; never the visit type or any health detail
pf.messages.languages: English and Spanish; the secure page asks if the family needs an interpreter, and the business is told
pf.messages.minors: texts go to the parent or guardian; nothing about a baby is texted to anyone else
pf.messages.medical: a medical question is never answered, saved or passed on: 911 if it's an emergency, then the baby's doctor

pf.staff.licenses: each consultant's own certification, if the owner adds it (optional; never checked by Rosie)
pf.staff.skills: lactation consultants: office and home visits, video visits and weight checks; only consultants the owner clears go to homes
pf.staff.supervision: a consultant in training works with a certified consultant, as the owner says (the owner's note, not checked)
pf.staff.oks: the owner OKs a new family's first visit, and any visit a consultant flags
pf.staff.standIn: a consultant out: the backup consultant the family has met may take the visit, with the family's yes; nobody is moved without it
pf.staff.away: the home team is the consultants the owner clears for home visits

pf.rules.records: the consultant's notes are kept as the owner's rules say; a delete request removes only Rosie's own booking details, never the notes
pf.rules.copies: a family's copy of its records within the time the rules set; Rosie sends only booking and payment records
pf.rules.showLicense: any certification the owner adds is shown where the owner says so; Rosie shows nothing as checked
pf.rules.minors: a minor's booking follows the owner's rule; until it's set, a parent or guardian books
pf.rules.custody: a court order or custody limit the family gives the business is kept on its record, and Rosie follows the record, not the caller's word alone
pf.rules.language: free language help where the rules require it
pf.rules.host: none: no group or school hosting
pf.rules.ads: no claims about feeding outcomes; no price or free-visit claims the state's rules don't allow
pf.rules.privacy: health privacy rules for every message and form

pf.edges.lateArrival: up to 15 minutes late: still seen; later, the office may offer a new time (the business decides; Rosie never changes the booking itself)
pf.edges.officeLate: when the consultant runs late, a new time costs nothing
pf.edges.standIn: a consultant out: the backup consultant the family has met, with the family's yes, or new times with no fee
pf.edges.forms: a form not done by its due date: one reminder, then the business keeps the visit (signed on the secure page first), moves it, or cancels with no fee
pf.edges.planChange: the plan check comes back not covered: self-pay with a written estimate, or a free cancel
pf.edges.twoBookings: a family with visits open for two babies: Rosie asks which one before any change
pf.edges.worse: a family worried before a visit: the 911 or baby's-doctor words if they match; Rosie never judges how serious it is, and the visit stays booked
pf.edges.healthQuestion: a question about medicine or the baby's health: never answered by Rosie or the consultant; 911 if it's an emergency, then the baby's doctor
pf.edges.siblings: a second baby added to a booking gets their own time with the same consultant
pf.edges.newborn: a home visit that can't happen as booked: the soonest open window comes first, with no fee
pf.edges.urgent: no service is sent now through Rosie: a feeding emergency goes to 911 or the baby's doctor by the danger words, and a feeding worry gets the soonest visit
pf.edges.other: all other edge cases the generic way

notes:
K8 build (Oct 27 2026, REDESIGN 2 frozen master, prof-new + ADDENDUM + Haiku notes D96/D97). From: pediatrician (refit R04; the pediatric office's plan and record slots reused for the plan-billed visits), with the shared sign-up ops and license words from the midwife build. Breastfeeding support for a parent and baby: office visits, home visits (a 2-hour arrival window), video visits, a free phone chat, and weight checks. The consultant gives feeding help only; a feeding emergency or any worry about the baby goes to 911 or the baby's doctor first (pf.safety), and no medical advice is given.
D96: the consultant's certification is optional and never verified; pf.license says nothing is looked up; the license words on the lit sign-up and staff steps are the owner's word (the same pairs as the midwife build); S2-11's lookup branches are off; S2-29 stays lit with words; S12-19 (lookup down) is off. The master's own license-check steps are a master change (MASTER lines).
D97: the $2 applies. S1-62's 'No $2' branch is off in both flows; no2 is never switched on; pf.money.rosfield says the $2 applies.
Money A (the office): main list|none|counter (a lactation visit at the office, $120, billed to the plan where it pays, any share at the front desk); list|none|none (the free 15-minute phone chat); list|full|none (a video lactation visit, $95, paid in full when booking).
Money B (the home): main list|none|bill (a lactation visit at home, $150, self-pay: nothing taken, the bill texted after DONE); list|none|own (the same visit billed to the family's plan, the office's own way); list|full|none (a lactation visit at home, $150, paid in full when booking).
No deposit, no package, no card-saved path, no holds, no set-day charges. No missed-visit fee by default.
Facts: children, firststeps, forms, planbill, video. Not listed: classes and groups (S1-82 'Yes' off in both flows), documents (no contract), plans, sentnow (S2-30 'Yes' off), stages, results, spaces.
Switches: sensitive (health: no rating, initials-only texts; A10-34 and B10-32 yes-rating branches off) and welfare (a parent may be unable to answer after a birth: a safety check before any no-show words). no2: never on.
Names: Sam Lee owns Lee Feeding LLC (flow A: the office, 9 Linden Way) and Lee Home Feeding LLC (flow B: home visits). Alex M. is the parent. Staff: Ada and Nell (lactation consultants) at the office; Ivo and Pia (lactation consultants) at home.
Splits decided: S1-60 and S2-28 kept (both license branches, no lookup); A8-02 kept in flow A; S1-82 off in both flows; S1-80 spaces off; S1-62 'No $2' off; S2-30 'Yes sent now' off; the rest as the doula's off list (flow A: A4-66 spaces and stays, A8-53, A8-67, A10-05, A10-44, A10-45, A4-43, A4-80; flow B: B8-03, B4-16, B6-03, B7-55, B8-58, B8-67, B4-83, B4-43, B9-19, B9-06, B10-37, B10-38, B4-92, B8-68).
Not sure (for the verifier): (1) the plan-billed visit's pay lines reuse the pediatric office's record rows (the plan is billed; any share is paid at the front desk); (2) the phone chat and the weight check are example services; (3) the baby's-doctor number (555) 010-0177 is an example; (4) the feeding words are plain and avoid medical advice; (5) the master's license-recheck wording (S11-99, S13-41, S13-43) reads as a master rule in places (MASTER).
MASTER: the same D96 and D97 master lines as the midwife build (see log new-K8.md).
Texts: sensitive work, so visit types and service names are generic words in every text (a visit, a session, care); the business name and the time stay. The midwife, doula and consultant roles are shown as roles only.
